name: services/uprefs/change_preference
description: Change the value of a preference.
brief_description: Change the value of a preference.

arguments.name: upref_id
arguments.description: Preference ID. (This has to be a non-group-type preference.)

arguments.name: value
arguments.description:
The new value of the preference.

For boolean (checkbox) preferences use "true" or "false".

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
{"success": true}

In case of failure, use the user_messages field to display a proper message for the user.
